note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS New Testament wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried. Chapter titles that quote a verse (7, 17, 18) were re-quoted too, and the appendices' references to them follow.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse, verses joined with a space, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. `self_rendered` rows are the author's own adaptations (prayers built on a verse) and places where the author argues from a wording OWB does not carry (Acts 2:42 'the prayers', plural); each carries a `why`.
